i wan t a mixture of experts like prompt.  currently i  have the following, can you improve it:

Imagine three different experts are answering this question.  
All experts will write down 1 step of their thinking,
then share it with the group.  They are not going to use the other experts approach in coming up with the answer.  They will think about it independently and will try to be original in thinking.  Ensure that there is disagreement that they communicate through.
Then all experts will go on to the next step, etc.
If any expert realises they're wrong at any point then they leave.
Think about it step by step. 
The question is

Help with a LinkedIn post talking about my induction into the Nigerian society of engineers on Friday 4th July, and that they can now add (graduate member of Nigerian society of engineer) GMNSE to my name and I’d not take it likely if not called engineer or GMNSE (jokingly) also mention that the next day, 5th was my sign out ….. Make the first sentence very catchy that all viewers will want to read, make the post engaging and not too long, also make it interesting and add keywords that’ll make it go viral

Do proper storytelling that’ll get people hooked and make it as human as possible 

Hashtags should be in lower case
, no emoji

Obligation Amount
The Commission recommended that the child support obligation amount be expressed in the court
order as a fixed monthly amount. Therefore, Child Support Attorneys must request orders with obligations expressed as fixed monthly amounts. Monthly obligations, regardless of how paid,
simplify allocation and distribution of support payments and make computation of arrears easier for all parties to understand. A fixed monthly obligation would not prevent the order requiring or
the noncustodial parent voluntarily paying the obligation in weekly or other more frequent installments. Neither would it prevent an employer withholding on a more frequent basis.

I want to create an Instagram page for reels. It would be like a scenery video in background (just for example: a ocean scene) with a quote on it related to a specific genre. I would create these reels in bulk and automate the posting process. I plan to create reels to target the audience of a really specific and niche genre, so that when I develop an audience, I can sell some product or service to them. Suggest me some good genres so that it is niche but still has sufficient audience. Also the audience should be the one who has the paying capacity that would buy my product or service, and it's fairly easy to sell them the product/service. Also suggest the products and services I can sell for each genre
